title: alnus incana f. microconus
intro: Alnus incana f. microconus, commonly known as Green Alder, is a variety of the White Alder (Alnus incana) plant. This shrub or small tree is native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa, and is valued for its medicinal properties. Green Alder has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, digestive issues, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit immunomodulatory, antiviral, and antiseptic activities.
